# read.ts — LLM Usage Guide

`read.ts` is a command-line tool for fetching news and reading web content.
It has three modes, inferred from the arguments.

---

## Mode 1: News list (`-s`)

Fetch article lists from news sources. Output is a JSON array on stdout.

```
npx tsx read.ts -s <sources> [-n limit] [-o output.json]
```

**Presets** (recommended):
- `-s news` → bbc + nytimes + xinhua + thepaper  (general news, EN+ZH)
- `-s tech` → hn + ars + mittr + infoq           (tech news, EN+ZH)
- `-s fin`  → caixin + wsj + cnbc:markets        (financial news, EN+ZH)

**Individual sources** (all HTTP, no browser required):
- `hn` Hacker News (EN) — score + comments in notes
- `bbc` BBC News (EN)
- `nytimes` NYT Chinese 纽约时报中文 (ZH) — full text accessible
- `xinhua` 新华社 (ZH) — official Chinese news wire
- `thepaper` 澎湃新闻 (ZH) — breaking domestic news
- `caixin` 财新 (ZH) — independent financial journalism
- `wsj` Wall Street Journal (EN) — RSS, summaries only (paywalled full text)
- `cnbc` CNBC (EN) — categories: top world markets tech finance us health politics intl ai
- `ars` Ars Technica (EN) — deep tech reporting, has `summary` field
- `mittr` MIT Technology Review (EN) — tech analysis
- `theverge` The Verge AI section (EN) — ~10 items
- `wiki` Wikipedia Current Events (EN) — curated digest, has `summary` field
- `zhwiki` 中文维基百科新闻动态 (ZH) — curated digest, has `summary` field
- `infoq` InfoQ CN (ZH)
- `techcrunch` TechCrunch (EN)
- `sina` 新浪新闻 (ZH)
- `people` 人民网 (ZH)
- `huggingface` HuggingFace Papers (EN) — daily ML papers
- `csdn` CSDN (ZH)
- `oschina` 开源中国 (ZH)
- `juejin` 稀土掘金 (ZH)

**Category syntax**: `source:category` e.g. `wsj:markets`, `cnbc:tech`, `xinhua:world`
- `wsj`: world us markets opinion main
- `cnbc`: top world markets tech finance us health politics intl ai
- `mittr`: ai computing space biotech (default: main RSS)
- `xinhua`: politics world society finance tech mil legal health edu

**Output format** (JSON array):
```json
[
  {
    "source": "hn",
    "title": "Article title",
    "url": "https://...",
    "notes": "412 points · 187 comments",
    "summary": "Optional excerpt (ars, wiki, zhwiki, wsj, caixin)"
  }
]
```

---

## Mode 2: Fetch full text (detail mode)

Pass URLs as arguments or via stdin. Output is Markdown on stdout.

```
npx tsx read.ts <url1> [url2 ...]
npx tsx read.ts -s hn -n 5 | jq -r '.[].url' | npx tsx read.ts
npx tsx read.ts <url> -o article.md
```

- Extracts main article body using Readability + Turndown
- Strips navigation, ads, "Read more" sections
- Output format: `---\n# title\n\nmarkdown body\n`
- Multiple URLs are separated by `---`
- Works well with: bbc, nytimes, ars, mittr, thepaper, caixin, xinhua, cnbc, wsj (summaries only)

---

## Mode 3: Search data sources (`-q`)

Search a reference source by keyword. Returns a JSON list of matching articles.

```
npx tsx read.ts -q wiki <keywords...>
npx tsx read.ts -q zhwiki <Chinese keywords...>
npx tsx read.ts -q wiki transformer architecture -n 8
```

**Searchable sources:**
- `wiki` — English Wikipedia full-text search
- `zhwiki` — Chinese Wikipedia (中文维基百科) full-text search

**Output format** (same as list mode):
```json
[
  {
    "source": "wiki",
    "title": "Transformer (deep learning)",
    "url": "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformer_(deep_learning)",
    "notes": "Wikipedia",
    "summary": "In deep learning, the transformer is..."
  }
]
```

**Typical usage pattern:**
```bash
# Find Wikipedia article, then read it in full
npx tsx read.ts -q wiki attention mechanism | jq -r '.[0].url' | npx tsx read.ts

# Search Chinese Wikipedia
npx tsx read.ts -q zhwiki 注意力机制 | jq -r '.[0].url' | npx tsx read.ts
```

---

## Options

| Flag | Short | Default | Description |
|------|-------|---------|-------------|
| `--sources` | `-s` | — | Source IDs, presets, or `all` |
| `--query`   | `-q` | — | Query source; keywords as positional args |
| `--limit`   | `-n` | `50` | Max results |
| `--out`     | `-o` | stdout | Write to FILE (JSON or markdown) |
| `--concurrency` | `-c` | `2` | Parallel sources (list mode) |
| `--loglevel` | `-l` | `warn` | debug\|info\|warn\|error |
| `--help`    | `-h` | — | Show help |

---

## Notes for LLMs

- **list mode** is passive: subscribe to sources to get a stream of article metadata
- **detail mode** is active: give it URLs from list output to get full readable text
- **query mode** is for reference lookup, not news; combine with detail for full articles
- All output is UTF-8; Chinese content is handled natively (GB2312 auto-decoded for Sina)
- Errors go to stderr; stdout is always clean JSON or markdown
- `wiki` and `zhwiki` are the best data sources: structured, reliable, full-text accessible
- `nytimes` (Chinese) provides high-quality full text; most other sources may be paywalled at detail level
